statement: This sketch creates a constantly shifting abstract composition through the interplay of flowing color bands and dynamic linear textures. The piece features bold, intersecting bands of color that move vertically across the canvas at different speeds and hues, creating a sense of depth and motion. Overlaid on this foundation are fine stripes that traverse the surface in various directions, adding intricate linear texture and further enhancing the dynamic quality. The composition evolves organically without any user interaction, with all elements moving independently according to their own timing and direction. The visual field continuously transforms as bands shift position and stripes reappear at different locations, creating a perpetual state of flux that maintains visual interest through the contrast between large-scale color movements and fine linear details.
